response.content: {"what_this_is": [{"text": "እዚ፦ ናይ ጥዕና መድሕን ክፍሊት ምንካይ ውሳነ እዩ። ደብዳበ ካብ Amt für Sozialversicherungen des Kantons Bern እዩ።", "support": ["e1", "e2"]}], "what_they_want": [{"text": "እቲ ደብዳበ ሓበሬታ ይህበኩም። ዝኾነ ነገር ኣይሓትትን።", "support": ["e1"]}], "deadline": [{"text": "እቲ ደብዳበ መወዳእታ ዕለት የብሉን።", "support": ["e1"]}], "what_you_can_do": [{"text": "እቲ ደብዳበ ዝኾነ ኣማራጺ ኣይገልጽን።", "support": ["e1"]}], "who_to_contact": [{"text": "ወግዓዊ ቤት ጽሕፈት፦ Amt für Sozialversicherungen des Kantons Bern, +41 31 636 45 00, asv.pvo@be.ch, https://www.asv.dij.be.ch, Forelstrasse 1, 3072 Ostermundigen።", "support": ["e2"]}]}
